detail: Terminations permitted from 2023-04-01 (CAA 2023 s.5131). States could begin renewals in Feb, Mar or Apr 2023 (renewals initiated from 2023-02-01 could end in disenrollment on or after 2023-04-01), had to initiate all renewals by 2024-03-31 and complete them by 2024-05-31. Some states received extensions.
DATA-Waiver (X-waiver) requirement eliminated by the Consolidated Appropriations Act, 2023 (MAT Act), signed 2022-12-29; DEA Dear Registrant letter 2023-01-12.
source_name: DEA Diversion Control Division letter A-23-0020 (2023-01-12)

detail: SUPPORT Act s.1006: mandatory Medicaid MOUD benefit (SSA 1905(a)(29)) effective 2020-10-01, originally through 2025-09-30; made permanent by CAA 2024 s.201. Hawaii, South Dakota and Wyoming received provider-shortage exemptions (see state rows).

Community engagement (work) requirement for expansion adults under SSA 1902(xx) (Public Law 119-21) begins 2027-01-01 unless a state implements sooner; good-faith exemptions may run no later than 2028-12-31. Applies to states covering the adult group under the state plan and to certain individuals covered through section 1115 demonstrations; MBAT v1.0 codes the federal indicator for ACA expansion states only (whether demonstration-only states such as Georgia are covered is not yet coded).
source_name: CMS, Community Engagement overview slides (medicaid.gov)

detail: Nebraska DHHS: work requirements for expansion adults (19-64) implemented 2026-05-01 for new applicants; existing members reviewed at renewal, first affected group with eligibility ending 2026-07-31, staged through June 2027.
source_name: Nebraska DHHS press release, 2026-04-30

detail: Montana DPHHS: community engagement requirements (80 hours/month, non-exempt expansion adults 19-64) beginning 2026-07-01; compliance reviewed at each member's next redetermination.
source_name: Montana DPHHS news release, 2026-03-31

detail: Iowa HHS: certain IHAWP members (adults 19-64 without an exclusion) must meet monthly community engagement requirements by 2026-12-01. PLANNED: date was in the future when retrieved; re-check at v1.1.
source_name: Iowa HHS, IHAWP Community Engagement Requirements page (updated 2026-10-08)

detail: Arkansas DHS: soft implementation of work and community engagement requirements (80 hours/month; ARHOME adults 19-64, non-exempt) from 2026-07-01; no penalties until 2027-01-01, when the full requirement launches and non-compliant enrollees can lose coverage.
source_name: Arkansas DHS news release, 2026-02-23

detail: Georgia Pathways to Coverage (section 1115): coverage for adults to 95% FPL (100% with the 5% income disregard), conditioned on at least 80 hours/month of qualifying activities; not ACA expansion. Implementation 2023-07-01 after CMS withdrawal (2021-12-23) was reversed by the court ruling of 2022-08-19.
source_name: Georgia DCH letter to CMS, 2023-02-24 (Medicaid.gov); launch confirmed by AP via News4Jax, 2023-06-30
